mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account(user_id, nickname, phone, password_hash, role, cinema_id, avatar_url, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{cinemaId}, #{avatarUrl}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
